record_title: Sharp pointwise-reversal threshold for stabilized CN/AB Allen–Cahn stepping
provenance: Sharp threshold refinement of the stabilized CN/AB pointwise-monotonicity counterexample in arXiv:2609.19023.
limitations: The if-and-only-if threshold assumes the exact homogeneous starter and classifies only the first post-starter increment. The nonhomogeneous extension is perturbative rather than a universal sharp threshold. The general alpha>1 statement concerns homogeneous over-extrapolated reaction forcing with a positive update factor. Cubic Allen-Cahn dynamics on 0<a<1 with periodic or homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions and exact arithmetic are assumed. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
